title.zh: 美国向Constellation提供50亿美元融资，以提升核能发电
title.en: 美国向Constellation提供50亿美元融资，以提升核能发电

current_state.zh: The Trump administration is preparing up to $5 billion in conditional DOE financing for Constellation Energy to upgrade nuclear reactors across three states, adding about 1.1 GW of generation capacity including supply for Google.
current_state.en: The Trump administration is preparing up to $5 billion in conditional DOE financing for Constellation Energy to upgrade nuclear reactors across three states, adding about 1.1 GW of generation capacity including supply for Google.
